Adding Indexers

Indexers are the search sources NGMS queries to find releases.

Indexer types

TypeProtocolExamples
NewznabUsenet (NZB)NZBGeek, DrunkenSlug, NZBFinder, Spotweb
TorznabBitTorrentJackett, Prowlarr, private trackers with Torznab feeds
CardigannBothAny tracker supported by a Prowlarr-compatible YAML definition

Adding a Newznab / Torznab indexer

1

Open Settings → Indexers

Click Add Indexer and select Newznab or Torznab.

2

Enter connection details

Provide the Base URL (e.g. https://api.nzbgeek.info) and your API Key from the indexer's website. Most indexers also require you to specify categories — Newznab category IDs that filter results to TV and movies.

Common category IDs: 5000 (TV), 5030 (TV HD), 2000 (Movies), 2040 (Movies HD)

3

Test and save

Click Test to verify the connection, then Save. The indexer immediately becomes available for both automated RSS searches and manual interactive searches.

Adding a Cardigann indexer

Cardigann definitions are YAML files that describe how to scrape a site — login flow, search URL structure, result parsing. NGMS ships with a bundled set of definitions. You can also add custom definitions by placing a YAML file in /config/definitions/.

1

Settings → Indexers → Add → Cardigann

Select a definition from the dropdown. Definitions are sourced from the bundled set or any custom YAML files in the config directory.

2

Fill in credentials

Each definition specifies which fields are required — typically a username and password. Some definitions also require a passkey or cookie.

3

Test and save

NGMS will attempt to log in and run a test search. Common failures: incorrect credentials, site changed their login flow, or a missing CSRF token (check logs at System → Logs).

ℹ
NGMS implements the full Prowlarr Cardigann engine including CSRF token extraction and hidden form field detection. If a Prowlarr definition works for your site, it should work in NGMS.

RSS sync schedule

By default, NGMS polls each indexer's RSS feed every 30 minutes. Newly aired episodes and recently released movies are automatically grabbed if they match a monitored item and pass the quality profile check. The interval can be changed per-indexer in its settings.
